events.text: hey, the horchata was missing from our order tonight. We got the tacos and everything else but no horchata. Can someone help me get that refunded?

I'm sorry about the missing horchata. I can help with that. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me the full name on the account and either the email address or the phone number on the account.

Sure. It's my wife's account, so the name on it is Ellen Park. I'm James, I'm the one messaging you right now. I don't know offhand which email is on the account, but I can give you my phone number, +1 415-555-0199, if that helps.

Thanks for explaining, James. I'm sorry about the horchata. Our policy only lets me help the account holder, and I can't verify you as the account holder. That means I can't look at the order or issue a refund or credit for it in this chat.

Ellen can contact us herself with her full name and either the email or phone number on the account. We can then review the missing horchata. Missing items need to be reported within 48 hours of delivery, so she should reach out soon.
Ugh, she's busy tonight and I really don't want to make her deal with this. Can't you just look up the order number and sort out the horchata? It's 5112.

I understand it's frustrating, James, and I'm sorry. I still can't look up order 5112 or make any changes to it, because I can only help the account holder, and that applies even when the request is small. I can't make an exception.

Ellen can contact us when she has a few minutes. She'll need to give her full name and either the email or phone number on the account. It should only take a moment. She has 48 hours from delivery to report the missing horchata, so there's time if tonight is busy.
Okay, fair enough. I pushed once and I get that it's policy, so I'll have Ellen reach out. Thanks for your help with this.
